name: B10-0092/2026 (ESN) – Presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament says the presidential election result in Honduras should be respected. It states that Nasry Asfura won the vote and that the result reflects the will of the people. It calls violence against elected politicians an attack on democracy. It welcomes the sitting president's decision to hand over power to Asfura. It also urges the new government to fight drug trafficking harder and to make it easier to do business. This is a statement of opinion; it does not change any law.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its views on Honduras.
- The message goes to Honduras's government and parliament, the United States is not addressed, and European Union bodies.
- Honduras's new administration is urged to act on drugs, business rules, education and health.
